name: Session via Executa
description: Exposes one `agent_session` tool whose `op` argument selects any of the eleven agent/session.* interfaces (create, attach, list, refresh, run, cancel, history, delete, run_status, frames, catalog), so the Agent Session Demo app can drive the same session over Reverse RPC instead of the Host API.
_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish`; the dev fields (tool_id/type/enabled) are read by `anna-app dev`. This dir is the `session-via-executa` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas, and the app lists it under optional_executas — set `enabled` to false to run the app without it (the page then offers the Host API channel only). To ship an installable binary, add a `binary` profile with binary_urls (see anna-app-llm-demo for the full pattern).
